Install a distribution

Source: R/install.R
ds_install.Rd

Installs the packages of a distribution that are not already installed at the expected version: missing and outdated packages, and also newer ones, which get downgraded to the pinned version.

Usage

ds_install(
  dist = "stable",
  side = "client",
  groups = NULL,
  lib = .libPaths()[1],
  repos = NULL,
  dry_run = FALSE,
  registry = ds_registry()
)

Arguments

dist

A distribution name or alias, or a `ds_distribution` object.

side

Side(s) to install: `"client"`, `"server"` or both.

groups

Groups to include, `NULL` for all. The groups they require are included too.

lib

Library to install into.

repos

Repositories to install from. `NULL` uses the distribution's snapshot, or `getOption("repos")` if it has none.

dry_run

If `TRUE`, only report what would be installed.

registry

A registry, see [ds_registry()]. Not used when `dist` is a `ds_distribution` object.

Value

The [ds_status()] data.frame after installation (before it when `dry_run` is `TRUE`), invisibly. An error is raised if any package is not at the expected version once installation is done.

Details

Package dependencies come from the distribution's CRAN snapshot (`repos` field), so that they are reproducible too. Pass `repos` to override it, for instance `repos = getOption("repos")` to get up-to-date dependencies.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ds_install("stable", side = "client", groups = "survival", dry_run = TRUE)
} # }
